retry_policy: LiteLLM backoff 0.5*2^n s (cap 8 s) + up to 0.75 s jitter; Retry-After <= 15 s honored, longer cools the tier and falls over

resolution.seed_mix: 50 YC startups + 53 labs from OpenRouter's directory

scale.two_worker_demo: 2 workers, 300 tasks, kill -9 worker A at 3 s → B reaps leases → 300/300 done, observations 300 = distinct tasks 300, RESULT PASS
scale.kill9_recovery: 12/12 tasks healed in 11.2 s, 0 duplicate observations
scale.projection_500k: pipeline ~2.8 h of stage work at 147 tasks/s; real limits are upstream (GitHub 5,000 req/h/token → ~1 h with GraphQL batches) and LLM token quotas

freshness_rule: export only if the whole publication interval lies inside [cutoff − 24 h, cutoff]; relative dates anchored to listing fetch time; zoneless dates widened ±14 h; conflicts quarantined; no-date items flagged 'new since last run' but never exported as fresh
anti_bot: structured feeds/APIs first; one polite client per site (stable UA, 2 concurrent, pacing, robots + Retry-After); challenges (Cloudflare, DataDome, captcha) detected and recorded as blocked — never bypassed; Ars Technica AWS WAF case → RSS kept, full text from other publishers
